activities.name: Golf
activities.whatToBring: Golf attire; clubs provided for the Clinic, bring or rent your own for the 18-hole round
activities.description: Two options at the hotel's own golf course. Contact Roland Stengele or Marcos Martinez in advance to book either one.
highlights: Beginner Clinic — 90 min, no experience needed. €35pp, min 6 / max 30 (larger groups split). Fixed price, advance booking required. Hotel provides clubs & equipment.
18-Hole Round — Monday, tee-off 14:00. ~€54pp, price varies with demand, buggy not included. No participant limit, valid golf licence required. Payment required to confirm; clubs not provided.
